verdict.rationale: Retell documents configurable per-agent data retention that automatically and permanently deletes transcripts, recordings, and logs after a set period for compliance. That covers the retention half of the story. The evidence never mentions per-call recording on/off controls, consent prompts, or disclosure features, so the recording-consent half is unevidenced. Retention is also set per agent rather than per call. Missing for 10: per-call recording controls, consent/disclosure announcement capability, per-call retention granularity, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: Configure per-agent data retention to automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs — after a set period for compliance.
After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
